apps.name: lvx-demo-hello
apps.title: Hello demo plugin
apps.summary: Demo plugin for LVX plugin/source/registry tests.
apps.description: A minimal LVX plugin that registers a 'hello' command. Used to exercise the plugin manager, software-source mechanism and the single-file .lvx container path. Install it once and `lvx hello` should greet you; `lvx plugin ls` lists it.
apps.author: hdhddhdhd

releases.notes: Single-file container distribution (plugins.lvx); store metadata introduced.
